correctness.rationale: Every one of the \(6^4=1296\) labeled strict profiles is examined against all three perfect matchings. Canonical quotienting under all 24 relabelings gives \(2,51,7,0\) classes with \(0,1,2,3\) stable matchings, and an independent Burnside computation gives the same numbers. Two implementations of the stability test agree on every profile; the embedded verifier returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Four agents are the first strict roommate size where nonexistence occurs. A complete isomorphism classification at this boundary is a natural exact invariant: it shows precisely how solvability and solution multiplicity distribute across the 60 unlabeled instances, identifies the two failure types, and records all automorphism strata. This is more informative than the already-known labeled solvability probability or unrefined orbit total.
